name: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited
remarksWeb: 1. My Happy Place Private Limited (MHPPL) is a private limited company incorporated on October 11, 2025, under the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, in which the majority stake is held by Dr. Ashar Agarwal (PAN: AJYPA1124E), Promoter of the Company and Ms. Kaamna Kakkar (PAN: BQOPK8401J), Promoter Group of the Company and accordingly MHPPL has been classified as part of the Promoter Group of the Company in accordance with the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.  2. With respect to the disclosure of Significant Beneficial Owners (SBO) in Table V of the Shareholding Pattern (SHP), we would like to clarify the following:  - As per our previous SHPs filed till the quarter ended September 30, 2025, with the stock exchanges:  a) Dr. Adil Agarwal (PAN: AEHPA3177M), b) Dr. Anosh Agarwal (PAN: AEUPA1650G),  c) Dr. Ashvin Agarwal (PAN: AJYPA1205E) and  d) Dr. Ashar Agarwal (PAN: AJYPA1124E)   were disclosed as the SBOs being the partners of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Institute (AEI) (PAN: AAAFD2391M). AEI is the Registered Owner of the shares of the Company held under the names of Dr. Adil Agarwal, Dr. Anosh Agarwal and Dr. Ashvin Agarwal.  - Therefore, four different row items were reported for the same Registered Owner.  - The above four SBOs were reported basis the clubbing of their shares indirectly held (together with their direct holding) through the below Registered Owners:  a) Dr. Agarwal's Eye Institute (PAN: AAAFD2391M) (shares held under the names of Dr. Adil Agarwal, Dr. Anosh Agarwal and Dr. Ashvin Agarwal) b) Dr. Agarwals Eye Institute (P) Ltd (PAN: AAACD2372H); and c) Dr. Anosh Agarwal holding on behalf of Dr. Adil Agarwal family trust (PAN: AAETD7890F) (i.e. Clubbed with Dr. Adil Agarwals holding only) d) Dr. Anosh Agarwal holding on behalf of Dr. Ashar Agarwal family trust (PAN: AAETD7891E) (i.e. Clubbed with Dr. Ashar Agarwals holding only) e) Dr. Anosh Agarwal holding on behalf of Dr. Ashvin Agarwal family trust (PAN: AAETD7892H) (i.e. Clubbed with Dr. Ashvin Agarwals holding only) f) Dr. Anosh Agarwal holding on behalf of Dr. Anosh Agarwal family trust (PAN:AAETD7893G) (i.e. Clubbed with Dr. Anosh Agarwals holding only)  - With respect to the SHP filed for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, the Company intends to keep the Exchanges informed that the Company has adopted the practice of disclosing all the above 4 SBOs (holding together and collectively) in a single row item thereby restricting one row item for one Registered Owner only which is better aligned to reflect the natural person behind each of such Registered Owners of the Company in accordance with the provisions of Section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (SBO) Rules 2018.  - Accordingly, we have made suitable modifications in Table V  (i.e., SBO holding) of the SHP for the quarter ended December 31, 2025.   - Additionally, since the SHP XBRL Utility accepts only a single PAN and Nationality to be disclosed for each of the SBOs, we have disclosed only the PAN and Nationality of Dr. Adil Agarwal (PAN: AEHPA3177M) against the line items for Dr. Agarwal's Eye Institute (PAN: AAAFD2391M) and Dr. Agarwals Eye Institute (P) Ltd (PAN: AAACD2372H)
